title: Dizzy, Burning, and Fighting for the Win

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Shortly after the Kikuka Sho, it's reported that Mihono Bourbon will be taking an extended break due to an injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon is upset not knowing when she'll be able to race again, and Rice Shower, who has always been chasing after her, is at a loss for how to continue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Matikanetannhauser worries about both of them, she gets a call from Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature expresses her gratitude to Matikanetannhauser for all the times she has given her courage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Matikanetannhauser remembers what Director Akikawa told her. "It's because you're you that they're so inspired!"
